content:
maria: quick syncpoint — planning a slim midnight cutover tomorrow (00:00-00:20 UTC). This is a rolling change across API, runtime, and router only, console read-only.
jonathan: ack. what's pinned where?
maria: API -> v2.3.1 (minor), runtime kernel -> v5.2-qopt, router shim -> 2.0.1 (pin), console stays at stable (no migrations).
kevin: runtime note: v5.2-qopt enables continuous batching change. Need to confirm kernel fallback path if batching causes latency spike. I've added fallback flag in deploy config.
sophia: added console gate: will block if any stats endpoint reports schema-mismatch. But we expect none — tested locally.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging at 2027-04-01T20:00:00Z, production at 2027-04-02T00:00:00Z. Rollout policy: sequential by region (us, eu, ap), pause on error or SLO breach.
maria: rollback criteria (short):
```
- 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m
- p95 latency increase > 200ms over baseline for 5m
- router error spike (connection failures) > 0.2% for 3m
- KV cache churn causing OOMs on runtime nodes
```
jonathan: add one more: routing mismatch where traffic pinned to new shim and requests see model-version header absent.
kevin: good call. I'll set an automated rollback trigger for header-mismatch logs count > 50 in 5m.
sophia: release notes snippet (for release page):
```
- API v2.3.1: minor param compatibility fixes, response schema stable
- Runtime v5.2-qopt: continuous batching and kernel selection improvements (opt-in)
- Router 2.0.1: shim pin to support batching keys
- Console: read-only visibility updates only
```
maria: ops checklist before prod flip:
- confirm canary in us-west for 15m (10% traffic) -> ok?
- run synthetic suite against pinned stack -> ok?
- update runbook w/ rollback steps and owner tags -> ok?
jonathan: canary ok, I'll monitor traces and model headers. tagging myself.
kevin: synthetic suite queued, baseline metrics uploaded to perf dashboard.
sophia: runbook updated and linked in the release note draft.
release-bot: release notes draft created: https://internal/release/3100001111 (access: eng-release).
maria: final check — any blocking deps (db schema, infra network)?
jonathan: infra called out no changes. DB team confirmed no migrations.
maria: ok let's proceed with the plan. If prod canary shows >0.3% 5xx within first 10m we abort and rollback to API v2.3.0 + runtime v5.1 kernel.
kevin: noted. I'll stand by to trigger rollback if metrics exceed thresholds.
sophia: will send post-cutover announcement and update release notes with final timestamps.
maria: thanks all. tagging @oncall for midnight window. :pray:
